references.purpose: four-direction tool-board layout only; rejected as scholar tool

prompt: Create one Realm strategy-game SCHOLAR HAND TOOL component board: an oversized readable goose-feather quill with a dark bronze nib, a small capped inkwell, and one compact rolled parchment pointer. Use the attached pewter-tankard board only for four-direction component layout, scale, crisp painterly raster treatment, warm upper-left lighting, and chroma-key setup; do not reuse its object shape. One large board containing four independently authored directional quill-and-ink arrangements for front/down, rear/up, left, and right, spaced far apart. The quill must remain readable after reduction to roughly 12x16 pixels, with a strong ivory feather silhouette and dark tip; inkwell should be a compact dark-blue glass/brass shape. Every object fully visible and uncropped. Perfect flat solid #ff00ff background; no hands, person, book, lectern, table, scenery, labels, borders, UI, extra props, duplicates, shadows, or watermark.
